turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    C --> C1[Compress to floor content]
    C1 --> C2[Name evaporated content and function]
    C2 --> C3[Locate operative sentence]
    C3 --> C4[Report ratio, erosion direction, and rough-edge flag]
    C4 --> C5[This is a finding, not a draft.]

    B -->|Draft prompt| D[PROVIDE]

    D1 -->|Yes| E[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]

    E2 --> E
    E1 -->|Yes| F[Compress the prompt]
    F --> F1{Cut removed specification?}
    F1 -->|Yes| F2[Revert the destructive cut]
    F2 --> F
    F1 -->|No| F3{Two empty cuts in sequence?}
    F3 -->|No| F4{Floor still passes?}
    F4 -->|No| F5[Return the last passing version]
    F4 -->|Yes| F
    F3 -->|Yes| G[Prompt is minimal]
    F5 --> G
    G --> H[Output the optimized prompt]
    H --> I{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    I -->|Keep negotiating| F
    I -->|Freeze and execute| J{Execution tools available?}
    J -->|No| K[Gate stays closed]
    J -->|Yes| L[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    L --> M{Result}
    M -->|Success| N[Done]
    M -->|Floor failure| O[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    O --> F
```
